rationale: Shared skeleton: detectors, gradient proxy dependence ratio (0.30/0.15), two 2x2 true-logit tests, sample ablation check. A: corpus phrase mining, factorial synthetic plus matched-pair notes, topic-covariate regressions with bootstrap, worst-case multi-set coefficient-removal greedy with topic-keep sweep. B: perfect-split detectors plus word/n-gram search, sample-gap-minus-property topic estimate, rank by g*coef with topic-cost skip.
